title: Construction Management for Vertical Construction Projects
short_description: Continuing program and construction management services for airport vertical construction projects in Orlando.
project_scope: Continuing management and oversight of primarily vertical construction projects for the Greater Orlando Aviation Authority. Typical delivery methods are design-bid-build and design-build. Potential project elements include general site construction, foundations, structural works, masonry, electrical, plumbing, mechanical systems, interior and exterior finishes, painting, roofing, furnishings, fixtures, furniture, planters, art installation, landscaping, ancillary horizontal works, and related works associated with vertical construction.
services: Continuing program management and construction management services for vertical construction projects.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a program/construction management procurement, not structural design or object planning.
- Covers broad vertical construction oversight rather than a specific technically demanding structure.
- No clear planning component in structural engineering, bridge design, or special structures.
- Airport-related vertical works may include structural elements, but the notice is too general and management-focused.
- Therefore only low strategic relevance for sbp.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee or engineering fee stated. The notice is for continuing program management and construction management services, so a realistic sbp fee cannot be derived from the available information.
references_qualifications: All disciplines requested. Up to four firms may be selected. No specific reference or qualification requirements are stated in the provided source.
